page.overview:
Who is Kozo Kanamori?

Kozo is a man of short height and slim build, with neck-length black hair that spikes near the ends. His hands are covered in visible blisters and he wears a Hyottoko mask over his face, as do all residents of the Swordsmith Village. His attire consists of a long, pale shirt with a black haori, and brown pants.

Unmasked, Kozo is revealed to have a long slender face, with thick teardrop-shaped eyebrows identical to his mask, narrow eyes, and a birthmark under his right eye.

Kozo appears as a gentle, soft-spoken individual. He is capable of understanding the hot-blooded Hotaru Haganezuka and cares for others very much, as seen when he continues to protect Hotaru against an attack from Gyokko, Upper Rank Five, despite being critically injured. He also showed great worry for Muichiro Tokito, anxiously watching him battle Gyokko and becoming hysterical upon seeing the Hashira fall unconscious from the demon's poison.

However, when it comes to his swords, Kozo is very passionate, almost as much as Hotaru to a certain extent. When Inosuke Hashibira purposefully chips the two blades he received from him, the swordsmith became furious and threatened to kill him for damaging his work.
